model: Structured literature review with identifier-verified metadata; no new physical data.
question: What are the best verified results that the H1 threshold (total propagation loss <= 0.3 dB/cm at 1550 nm) and the H-B crossing argument must be compared against?

sources: publisher pages and abstracts found by web search
reference lists of included records (one level of snowballing)
queries: femtosecond laser written waveguide propagation loss 1550 nm fused silica
depressed cladding waveguide femtosecond fused silica 1550 nm loss
multiscan femtosecond waveguide low loss fused silica
femtosecond laser written waveguide bend loss radius 1550
femtosecond laser written waveguide crossing insertion loss crosstalk
three-dimensional photonic neural network femtosecond laser glass
femtosecond laser written programmable photonic processor 1550 nm
tubular depressed cladding waveguide fused silica heat accumulation 0.3 dB/cm
inclusion: Waveguides written by femtosecond laser in a glass (fused silica, borosilicate, aluminoborosilicate, SK-1310 or other silicate glass).
A quantitative loss figure (propagation, bend or crossing) with its wavelength, or a fs-written programmable or 3D photonic network.
Peer-reviewed article, conference paper with DOI, or arXiv preprint.
exclusion: Records whose identifier cannot be verified by verify_refs.py.
Press releases and secondary summaries without the primary record.
search_strategy.value_verification: Each extracted number records where it appears (abstract, section, table or figure). Numbers taken only from an abstract are labeled abstract_only.

decision_rules.R1: S1550 = lowest verified propagation loss of a single-mode fs-written waveguide in fused silica measured at 1530-1565 nm with a stated method. If S1550 < 0.3 dB/cm, the 0.3 dB/cm threshold of H1 is labeled a feasibility threshold, not a state-of-the-art claim, and a secondary hypothesis H1-SOTA with threshold S1550 is registered under the same three-zone rule.
decision_rules.R2: If no verified record satisfies R1, the lowest verified value at any near-infrared wavelength is reported as wavelength-mismatched and no H1-SOTA threshold is set.
decision_rules.R3: The lowest verified depressed-cladding (type III) loss at 1530-1565 nm in any glass is reported separately as the closest-geometry comparator.
decision_rules.R4: XC = lowest verified insertion loss per crossing for fs-written glass waveguides (any wavelength, flagged). It is the input for the T25 break-even comparison; if none is verified, the crossing loss is declared the decisive unknown for H-B.
decision_rules.R5: Every 3D or programmable fs-written photonic network found is added to the novelty table with what it does and does not cover relative to claims (a)-(e) of Docs/NOVEDAD-ESTADO-20261011.md.

resource_limits.network: public bibliographic APIs and web pages only

heldout_policy: Not applicable: literature review. Records are collected before any H1 measurement exists; no project data are used.
